alert_news.title: India's First Commercial Thermal Payload in Space Launched by SatLeo Labs
bullets: SatLeo Labs’ TAPAS‑1 became India’s first commercial thermal payload in space when it reached orbit on 1 Oct 2026 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9.
The microsatellite uses thermal sensors and onboard AI to map Earth’s temperature, marking the first commercial thermal satellite mission from India.

alert_news.title: India's First Quadrupedal Athletic Showcase Held in Bengaluru
bullets: Bharat1.ai hosted India’s first quadrupedal athletic showcase at the AI & Robotics Pavilion during the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026.
The event featured three home‑grown quadrupedal robots racing 100 m, marking the first such competition in India.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous H5N1 Chicken Vaccine Dedicated
bullets: ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal developed India’s first domestically produced inactivated H5N1 vaccine for chickens, targeting clade 2.3.2.1a.
The vaccine, dedicated on 20 Nov 2026, is the first Indian vaccine specifically designed to protect poultry against this HPAI strain.

alert_news.title: GIFT City Becomes India’s First MCR2030 Resilience Hub Recognised by UNDRR
bullets: India’s first Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030) Resilience Hub – GIFT City, Gujarat – designated by UNDRR Asia‑Pacific.
GIFT City joined MCR2030 in July 2022, developed a resilience pathway with risk assessments, emergency response measures, and will serve as a knowledge‑sharing hub for other Indian cities.

alert_news.title: CIAL Operationalises India’s First Transfer Cargo Security Hold Area
bullets: India’s first Transfer Cargo Security Hold Area (TCSHA) – operationalised at Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL), Kochi.
TCSHA, developed under guidelines of the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security, CISF and Customs, reduces transfer cargo screening to 5 % randomised checks, cutting dwell time and handling costs.

alert_news.title: Air India and Airbus Sign Feasibility Study for India’s First Voluntary Corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel Programme
bullets: India’s first voluntary corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) programme – feasibility study signed by Air India and Airbus on 17 Nov 2026.
Programme will procure and use SAF on selected routes, issue SAF certificates to corporate customers, and aims to reduce lifecycle emissions from business travel.

alert_news.title: India’s First AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab Launched by IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai
bullets: India’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab dedicated to securing AI systems in the financial sector, launched by IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai on 18 November 2026.

The lab will test AI systems used in banking, payments, lending and insurance, and will train more than 300 students and professionals annually using advanced AI computing infrastructure and cloud resources.

alert_news.title: India’s First Complementary Inter‑State Pumped Storage Power Procurement between MP and UP
bullets: First complementary inter‑state pumped storage procurement between Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh, 500 MW capacity with 6‑hour storage and a 40‑year PPA.
Seasonal capacity‑sharing model: MP uses the capacity from November to April, UP from May to October, reducing procurement cost and enhancing renewable energy integration.

alert_news.title: India's First Government-Driven AI University to be Built in Karnataka
bullets: Karnataka government is constructing India’s first government‑driven AI University, featuring an AI Hub to integrate startups, researchers and industry
The university will serve as a national centre of excellence for AI research, education and innovation

alert_news.title: AIIMS Delhi Repairs a Baby's Spinal Defect Inside the Womb in India's First Open Foetal Surgery
bullets: AIIMS Delhi performed India's first open foetal spinal surgery to repair a lumbosacral myelomeningocele at 25 weeks gestation.
The multidisciplinary team of 37 doctors operated for over six hours, successfully repairing the defect and allowing the pregnancy to continue.

alert_news.title: Cold Calling: Film chronicles how scientists braved extreme conditions to build India's first ...
bullets: India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica, established during the 1983–84 summer season by a joint team of Indian scientists and armed forces.
Built in a single Antarctic summer (six months), the station remains operational, enabling year‑round scientific research.
The station was constructed under the Indian Antarctic Programme, marking India’s entry into sustained polar research.

alert_news.title: Dholera becomes India's first semiconductor city
bullets: Dholera Special Investment Region (DSIR) in Gujarat is India's first semiconductor city, developed by the Gujarat government and the Ministry of Electronics & IT.
The city hosts the Tata Electronics Semiconductor Fabrication Facility, marking a major step in India's semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.

alert_news.title: Smart AI Navigation Enables India's First Day Care Bilateral Hip Replacement at Max Super ...
bullets: India's first day‑care bilateral total hip replacement performed at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, using Smart AI Navigation technology.
Procedure on a 40‑year‑old patient with same‑day discharge, marking the first of its kind in India.
Smart AI Navigation enabled precise implant positioning and early mobilisation, allowing same‑day discharge.

alert_news.title: India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica
bullets: India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica, established in 1971 during the country’s third expedition to the continent
Built in a single Antarctic summer (six months) by a team of 81 scientists and Army, Navy, and Air Force personnel
Location: Antarctica; significance: enabled continuous year‑round scientific research in the region

alert_news.title: CSL, NeST Unveil India First Hybrid Laser Arc Welding Tech
bullets: India’s first indigenously designed Hybrid Laser Arc Welding (HLAW) technology unveiled by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) and SFO Technologies at the Advanced Laser Engineering Centre, Kalamassery, Kochi.
The system integrates a 12 kW fibre laser, a six‑axis industrial robot and MIG welding, achieving welding speeds of up to 2 metres per minute for automated ship panel fabrication.

alert_news.title: NIBE Successfully Tests Made-in-India SURyaSTRA Universal Rocket Launcher up to 300 km
bullets: India’s first domestically produced Universal Rocket Launcher System (URLS) – SURyaSTRA – successfully tested by NIBE Limited at the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha.
The platform delivers a 300 km strike range with a circular error probable of less than 5 metres and can launch 122 mm, 160 mm and 306 mm rockets from a single modular launcher.

alert_news.title: Mysuru Gets India's First 8K LED Dome Planetarium Where You Can Explore The Universe
bullets: India’s first 8K‑resolution LED dome planetarium – COSMOS‑Mysuru – inaugurated on the University of Mysore campus, Mysuru.
The 15‑metre tilted dome contains ~6,150 LED panels, over 4.27 crore LEDs, 8K resolution and is powered by 14 master computers for real‑time astronomical visualisations.
